notes: Both coders gave delegates for both university-layer documents. Main disagreements: (1) policy_type: customizable templates sentence (A P04, B P110; resolved P110, the source says 'templates'); equity-under-bans note (A UNCOVERED, B P51; resolved UNCOVERED because P51 is about cost and access); welcome-innovation sentence (A P02, B P56; resolved P56, an institutional posture not a student-use default); punitive-consequences caution (A P68, B UNCOVERED; resolved UNCOVERED, no educative response is prescribed). (2) phase and actor on DLI data-handling and approval lines (general vs during-work; admin vs all); resolved to general and all because the rules are not tied to coursework and address anyone seeking to use a tool. (3) modality: wording-note (must-not vs should-not, resolved must-not from 'Do not include both') and punitive caution (informs). (4) unit_stance differences (P29, P77, P78, P65) resolved by whether the passage itself takes a position on AI use. Only-B units kept: option 1 attribution duty, instructor-discretion clause, option 3 'strongly discouraged' variant (split from 'not permitted' as P06), 'potential to revolutionize' benefit claim, and the data-risk warning. Only-B units dropped as non-policy: past-events list, references to other universities, feedback email line. Only-A unit kept: list of considerations (privacy, compliance, copyright, academic integrity). The Guidelines for Responsible Use (KB15409) were not fetched by either coder, so no units come from them.
